subject: Re: Encryption & key evidence request — Stellar Systems
messages:
From: Aaron Feldman <aaron.feldman@stellarsys.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: security@stellarsys.com
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Encryption/key mgmt artifacts for SIG + CAIQ

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick turn so far. As part of our SIG/CAIQ review we need a compact evidence packet focused on encryption and key management (KMS/HSM). Can you confirm whether the following items are available and, if so, share them (or a secure download) by EOD Friday (US PST):

- HSM vendor attestation (FIPS 140-2/3 level and HSM vendor name + date of attestation)
- Key rotation logs for the last 12 months (UTC timestamps, key IDs, rotation type: automatic/manual)
- Overview of envelope encryption / key wrapping approach and the KMS role (diagram OK)
- TLS cipher suite and minimum TLS version for inbound API traffic + mutual TLS details if supported
- Evidence of BYOK/Customer-managed key option (how customer keys are ingested and rotated)
- Any SOC 2 / SIG-specific mapping docs you have for KMS controls (short index acceptable)

We can take redacted logs for PII/secret reasons as long as timestamps and key IDs are preserved. Also include any short README that explains filenames and retention windows.

Appreciate it — Aaron

--
Aaron Feldman
Senior InfoSec Program Manager | Stellar Systems
security@stellarsys.com

- HSM attestation PDF (vendor redacted if requested)
- KMS rotation log CSV (2025-11-01 -> 2026-11-01) with UTC timestamps

I'll loop in our security lead — Vivek — and our CSM — Laura — to coordinate timing and redaction.

Best,
Marissa Cole

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Delivering Stellar encryption evidence packet (SIG/CAIQ)

Aaron — attaching the evidence packet per your request. Below is a short contents index and notes on redaction. If you prefer a different delivery link we can rotate credentials and re-upload.

Contents delivered (secure link): https://drive.google.com/secure/drivefq/1aB2cKMS-architecture-diagram
- hsm-attestation-latest-2026-09.pdf (vendor: Thales HSM; FIPS 140-2 level 3, attestation date: 2026-09-14) — internally redacted only for device serials
- redwood_kms_rotation_log_2025-11_to_2026-11.csv (UTC timestamps; columns: timestamp_utc, key_id, rotation_type, actor)
- kms-deployment-diagram.png (envelope encryption flow: customer plaintext -> data key (DEK) envelope-wrapped by CMK in HSM -> encrypted payload stored in object store)
- tls-summary.txt (min TLS 1.2, TLS 1.3 preferred; ciphers: TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384; client certs supported via mTLS on Dedicated)
- kms-evidence-bundle-README.txt (maps files to SIG/CAIQ control identifiers; describes redaction policy and retention window)

Notes / clarifications:
- BYOK: we support a BYOK path where customers provide a wrapped key material bundle via KMS import. For Dedicated customers we offer a customer-managed KMS integration (details in README).
- Rotation cadence: platform CMKs rotate on a 12-month cadence by default; tenant data keys (DEKs) rotate per-tenant policy and can be configured down to a 30-day cadence. The CSV includes the rotation_type field (automatic/manual) and actor column (service-account/system or admin user id) so you can validate operator model.
- Redaction: logs redact tokenized resource names but preserve key IDs (kp-####) and timestamps. No plaintext key material is included in any delivery.

If you need the raw vendor attestation (no redaction) we can request a controlled release agreement — let us know and Laura will coordinate the legal flow. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HS-4719.

Thanks, and happy to jump on a quick call if the Stellar security team wants to walk through the artifacts.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
